comment: One row for each check that the local ownership increment adds or depends on.
A row names the line that holds the check and the text that breaks it.
The build compiles working-tree HEAD with the mutant. The module tests compile
src/fort with the mutant too. The stages run from the narrowest tests to the
driver test. The table runs in the Linux VM with the debug preset.
The md5 guard reads the product compiler that the build links. Use the
The first stage runs ownership_flow_test for the loan capture rows (D17.10).
